title: Recording: To You by Wings | 1978
content:
Spirit of Ranachan Studio, Low Ranachan Farm, Campbeltown, Scotland
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Mark Vigars, Tim Summerhayes

Wings began recording their seventh and final studio album Back To The Egg on 29 June 1978.

They worked on the song ‘To You’ during the session, which took place at the McCartneys’ Spirit of Ranachan Studio in Campbeltown, Scotland.

This first session was primarily filled with jamming, to allow Wings – including new members, guitarist Laurence Juber and drummer Steve Holley – to get used to their new surroundings.

There was also a co-producer, a rarity for Wings. Chris Thomas had worked with The Beatles on the White Album, and had worked on the audio for the more recent Wings Over The World and Rockshow films.
